headlines: CRWV Stock On Track For 4-Day Slide Amid CoreWeave's Debt Test (TradingView/Stocktwits)
Why Is CoreWeave (CRWV) Stock Down -10.99% Today? (ATM up to 35M shares + $3.0B converts due 2033; article date unverified)
gappers.catalyst_detail: CRWV is on a multi-day slide as its bond yields spiked, putting its heavy debt load in focus; an earlier-reported ATM program (up to 35M shares) plus a $3.0B convertible notes offering adds dilution/financing-overhang. Analysts split: some call the selloff overdone.
gappers.why: Rising cost of debt and dilution fears hit a highly levered AI-infrastructure builder; momentum sellers pile on.
gappers.impact: Volume 453K premarket on a -7.4% gap after a 4-day slide reads as sustained repricing, not a one-day spike. Neocloud peer NBIS also gapping down (sector read-through).
gappers.horizon_reason: Financing/debt-driven selloff, no durable long thesis until credit spreads stabilize.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Gap-down falling knife, no long setup; fails 200-SMA/momentum bias. Caps are open but a 2:1 R:R at a sane stop is unlikely; NBIS is the only comparable sector name. Research only.

headlines: Is Analyst Upgrade Altering The Investment Case For Nebius Stock (NBIS)? (Simply Wall St; older)
Nebius Gains 42% in 3 Months (Globe and Mail; older)
gappers.catalyst_detail: No fresh company news surfaced for today. Background: Nebius recently joined the FTSE All-World Index, reported strong AI cloud revenue with customer prepayments and a multi-year Meta contract, and is raising prices on some Nvidia GPU instances. Up ~42% over 3 months, so it is extended going into the CRWV-led sector pullback.
gappers.why: Sector sympathy: CRWV's debt scare hits neocloud peers sharing capex-funding risk; profit-taking after a large run.
gappers.impact: Volume only 89K, light vs CRWV, so the move reads as sympathy/profit-taking, likely to follow CRWV. Strong fundamentals (Meta contract, prepayments) argue against a thesis break.
gappers.horizon_reason: Sympathy move with no company catalyst; wait for CRWV/credit stabilization before any swing view.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Better-quality name than CRWV, but same sector as the falling peer; dip-buy would compete for 1 of 3 weekly slots and a 10% trail on a ~$177 stock is wide for 2:1 R:R while the sector is unsettled. Research only.
